scientific.integrity: The printed FAdam first step is reconstructed exactly. The first Fisher bias-correction coefficient vanishes, so the adaptive epsilon scales linearly with a small scalar gradient and cancels its magnitude in the natural-gradient denominator. The claimed objective amplification is derived algebraically on a strongly convex quadratic and replayed independently.
limitations: Current paper-form Algorithm 1 only; software may add a safeguard.
First-step local result on a deterministic scalar strongly convex quadratic.
Uses the displayed default hyperparameters and any positive first scheduled learning rate.
Does not claim that safeguarded FAdam variants share the singularity.

title: FAdam's adaptive epsilon has a stationary-point singularity and fixed local jump
